title: West Bengal Professional Tax (P-Tax): Enrolment, Deduction & Form III Filing
summary: Comprehensive breakdown of employer registration (EC), professional enrolment (RC), and GRIPS portal payments.
body:
Under the West Bengal State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1979, every business employing staff must hold an Enrolment Certificate (EC) and Registration Certificate (RC).

Compliance Framework:
• Monthly Deductions: Slotted deductions ranging from ₹90 to ₹200 based on gross salary slabs.
• Monthly GRIPS Deposit: Payment due on or before the 21st of the succeeding month.
• Annual Return (Form III): Mandatory filing before April 30 summarizing annual deductions.

Defaults incur penal interest at 1% per month. Get your P-Tax registration processed at our [Chandannagar & Chinsurah Desk](/locations/chandannagar-chinsurah).
